name: generate-tests-from-implementation
description: Study an implementation and generate edge case tests for its error paths. Test generation task.
task: The EditFileTool at Sources/Yrden/Tools/EditFileTool.swift has several error paths that aren't well tested. Read the implementation, figure out what can go wrong, and write edge case tests at Tests/YrdenTests/Unit/Tools/EditFileEdgeCaseTests.swift. Cover at least: invalid inputs, file not found, and the ambiguous-match case. Use XCTest and reference the actual error messages from the implementation. Do NOT attempt to compile or run the tests - just write the test file.
